messages:
From: Ida Morales <ida@innovatorhub.com>
To: Stephanie Nguyen <stephanie_nguyen@redwood.ai>
Date: Mon, 1 Dec 2025 09:12:00 -0800
Subject: Welcome pool realignment + tax questions

Hi Stephanie,

Thanks again for the walkthrough yesterday — Innovator Hub is excited about piloting Redwood for the founder tools cohort launching in January. I wanted to follow up with two asks so we can finish our internal approval: 1) our cohort budget is tight and we'd like to request a reallocation of the standard welcome pool — instead of the default one-time $1,000 trial credit, can we get a $3k "welcome pool" split across the first 3 months (monthly consumption buckets)? 2) on the accounting side: Innovator Hub is a 501(c)(3) nonprofit. Can you confirm whether promotional credits are considered taxable revenue for Redwood (i.e., will you be issuing an invoice that we need to record)?

I've attached a short SOW and list of cohort headcounts to give context (attachment: Innovator_Hub_SOW.pdf). If you need any additional docs (EIN, W-9), tell me what you need and we'll send it.

Would prefer to close this before Fri so we can mention the credits in the cohort acceptance emails.

Best,
Ida Morales
Head of Partnerships
Innovator Hub

Attachments: Innovator_Hub_SOW.pdf (PDF, 120KB)

From: Stephanie Nguyen <stephanie_nguyen@redwood.ai>

Cc: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.ai>, Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.ai>

Subject: Re: Welcome pool realignment + tax questions

Hi Ida — great to hear, and congrats on the cohort launch.

Short answers up front: we can support a $3,000 welcome pool for pilot cohorts on a case-by-case basis; we treat promotional credits differently depending on accounting classification (we'll need a W-9/EIN to confirm tax treatment for the US). I'll loop in Ben (sales) and Laura (finance) to finalize the structure and any contractual language.

Proposed next steps:
- I will draft a short amendment to your onboarding MA that: 1) defines the $3,000 welcome pool, 2) details monthly bucket release (months 1-3), and 3) lists conversion options to Dedicated pricing if you exceed X tokens/month.
- Please send your EIN/W-9 so our finance team can confirm whether the credit is accounted for as a marketing/promotional contra or as taxable revenue.
- If you approve, we'll send a DocuSign amendment and a usage dashboard link so you can monitor the bucket.

Tentative numbers here (subject to finance sign-off): $3,000 total welcome pool, released as $1,000/mo for 3 months. Unused credits will expire at month 4. No automatic conversion to a paid commitment.

I attached a short PDF with the proposal outline (redwood-welcome-pool-proposal.pdf). If that structure works, I'll prepare the amendment and timeline.

Thanks —
Sincerely,
Stephanie Nguyen
Account Executive, Startups & Accelerators
Redwood Inference

Attachments: redwood-welcome-pool-proposal.pdf (PDF, 45KB)

Thanks for the context, Stephanie — this looks fine to approve with two conditions:
1) The $3k welcome pool is a one-time promotional credit, explicitly non-recurring and tied to cohort IDs (we should list cohort names/IDs in the amendment).
2) Innovator Hub provides EIN/W-9 before credits are activated. If finance flags taxability, we reserve the right to issue a nominal invoice offset by the credit (so their net payment remains zero) — that keeps our revenue recognition clean.

Laura — can you confirm whether finance will accept the EIN/W-9 route and advise on wording for the amendment that covers tax treatment? If we get a quick ok, Stephanie please send the DocuSign MA amendment draft and I'll approve it on my side.

Ida — looping you so you're aware of the conditions. Happy to expedite once we have the docs.

Best,

From: Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.ai>
To: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.ai>, Stephanie Nguyen <stephanie_nguyen@redwood.ai>, Ida Morales <ida@innovatorhub.com>
Date: Mon, 1 Dec 2025 13:40:00 -08:00
Subject: Re: Fwd: Welcome pool realignment + tax questions (Innovator Hub)

Hi all — finance reviewed. We can treat the $3,000 as a promotional contra (not taxable revenue) provided Innovator Hub supplies an EIN and a completed W-9. If they cannot provide a W-9 (non-US entity) we will require their local tax-equivalent docs and may need a nominal invoice/offset approach as Ben suggested.

Suggested amendment language (short):
"Redwood will grant Innovator Hub a one-time promotional credit in the aggregate amount of USD $3,000 (the 'Welcome Pool'), to be released in three equal monthly installments beginning on the cohort start date. The Welcome Pool is promotional in nature and is not payment for services. Activation of credits is contingent on receipt of Innovator Hub's tax documentation (EIN and W-9 for US entities). Redwood reserves the right to issue a nominal invoice offset by the Welcome Pool if local tax treatment requires transaction-level invoicing."

Stephanie — that's finance-approved. Please send the DocuSign amendment (use the MA-IH-2025 template) and include cohort IDs in the schedule. Ida — if you can provide the W-9 and expected cohort IDs today or tomorrow we'll push the amendment and activate the first monthly bucket on cohort start.

Laura Bennett
Sr. Finance Manager, Revenue Operations
Redwood Inference

Attachments: finance-accounting-note.pdf (PDF, 12KB)
